subject: RSVP failover & countdown cadence for 'Serving LLMs at Scale' — please review
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: RSVP failover & countdown cadence for 'Serving LLMs at Scale' — please review

Team — putting all of the pieces in one thread so we can lock the send plan. Goal: 1,200 registrants, 25% engineer-targeted attendees, and <3% bounce on reminder links. Key open items: failover tracking links, final countdown cadence copy (48/24/3/1 hours), and the RSVP reminder subject A/B test.

High-level plan (attached spreadsheet has the link matrix):
- Primary invite (day 0): send from ‘Redwood Inference’ with subject variant A/B (see sheet).
- Wave reminders: 48h, 24h, 3h (engineer segment only), 1h last-chance.
- Failover links: two fallback tracking endpoints — an immediate redirect to the landing page plus a static 'backup' landing hosted on Acme Events (in case HubSpot link shortener throttles). See tracking-links-v2.csv.

Asks:
1) Marissa — can you confirm the subject line variants and drop them into column B of the sheet? Prefer one subject targeted at platform engineers and one more exec/CTO-level.
2) Mateo — please confirm the HubSpot tracking tokens and that the fallback static link is live with Acme Events. If you approve, forward to Emily to sanity-check downstream co-marketing tracking.
3) Vivek — can you sign off on the 3-hour ‘engineer quick lab’ reminder content below? We want it short and high-signal.

Draft countdown copy (short):
- 48h (subject: Save your spot — Serving LLMs at Scale)
  Body: 48 hours left. Join us for a 40-min technical session + live Q&A. Add to calendar: [attachment: calendar-preview-ics.ics].

- 24h (subject: 24 hours — live demo & optimizer tips)
  Body: Quick reminder — demo of batching + quantization. Limited seats for hands-on lab.

- 3h (subject: Lab seats filling fast — 3 hours left)
  Body: Short reminder targeted to engineers: bring a prompt set and your questions. Link: {engineer-link}.

- 1h (subject: Starting in 1 hour — join live)
  Body: Final nudge with fallback link included (both hubspot and static).

Attached: invite-email-variants.xlsx — includes hero copy + preview images. Tracking matrix is tracking-links-v2.csv.

Thanks — can we get confirmations by EOD so I can lock the scheduled send windows?

— Camila
Camila Reyes | Sr. Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference

On Thu, Apr 12, 2028 at 09:05 AM Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — putting all of the pieces in one thread so we can lock the send plan. Goal: 1,200 registrants...

Looks great. Quick notes:
- Subject line A/B: my picks are 1) "Serving LLMs at Scale: practical batching & cost wins" and 2) "How teams reduce inference cost by 3-5x — live demo". I'll drop both into the spreadsheet by noon.
- CTA: let's test a secondary CTA that goes straight to the registration modal (less friction) vs. primary CTA to the blog-first page. Put that as CTA-B in the link sheet.
- Copy tweak for 3h — suggest: "Bring one real prompt and we’ll show optimization live" (shorter).

Also: include a short plain-text fallback for Gmail clipping; many of our invites get clipped at scale. Add a 300-char plain-text summary under the main HTML.

I approved the invite variants in the spreadsheet and added a brief preview note in column F.

— Marissa

1) The static fallback landing hosted on Acme: https://acme.events/redwood-llm-backup
2) The HubSpot -> redirect matrix: (see tracking-links-v2.csv attached).

"3 hours until the hands-on lab: bring one real prompt and see batching + KV-cache tricks in action. Quick join link: {engineer-link} — if that link fails, use our backup: https://acme.events/redwood-llm-backup"

Attachments: tracking-links-v2.csv, invite-email-variants.xlsx

Can you confirm the backup page will accept simple GET params (utm_source=redwood&utm_campaign=serve-llm-0428) and that we can hot-swap the shortlink if HubSpot rate-limits? Also confirm a co-brand logo placement in the footer — Marissa listed the render sizes in the sheet.

If this looks good, Camila will schedule the initial send for next Tuesday 10:00 AM PT and the reminder cadence will follow as outlined.

Thanks — Mateo

- Co-brand: fine — we’ll provide a transparent PNG (300x80) by Monday.

Also, we tested the 3-hour engineer copy and it reads well. One micro tweak: change "bring one real prompt" -> "bring one real prompt (optional)" to reduce perceived friction for observers who don't want to prepare.

We'll confirm calendar integration on our side once we receive the calendar-preview-ics.ics file.
